identity.name: Awesome Bot
identity.mark: four-cell circular mark with a single red cell

typography.family: IBM Plex Sans (self-hosted, SIL OFL 1.1) with platform Chinese sans fallbacks

motion.reducedMotion: remove smooth scrolling; reduce transitions and animations to 0.01ms and one animation iteration

principles: Use thin-rule rows for directory density instead of a card wall.
Keep source, version, license, and requested permissions visible.
Use a pressed button group for collection filtering and keep the result surface in place.
Draw external, download, and close marks with authored CSS shapes while keeping labels accessible.
Use a self-hosted OFL font plus platform Chinese fallbacks and relative assets so GitHub Pages stays portable.
Treat missing data, empty results, and untested real tasks as visible states.

responsive.wide: header, search, filters, list, and utility rail fit within 1180px; default side gutters are 24px
responsive.medium: at max-width 930px the utility rail moves below the list; at max-width 760px side gutters become 16px and the first result action stays beside its row content
responsive.small: at max-width 760px navigation simplifies and rows keep the detail action beside the content; at max-width 480px side gutters become 12px and the dialog has an 8px outer margin

safety.downloads: static configuration files; counts are data-driven; null bulk URLs show a per-entry fallback without an href
safety.permissions: requested capabilities are descriptive and never treated as granted
safety.provenance: source authors and template authors retain distinct labels; format and import checks do not certify real task execution
safety.icons: authored CSS shapes; no Unicode icon glyphs for external, download, or close actions; the external-link diagonal uses a linear-gradient as icon geometry
safety.focus: visible outline plus soft focus-within shadow for the search field
